title: The Unquiet Verdict
author: Isandro Villalobos
blurb: Paloma Kavanagh, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
